name: pulse-verity
description: Read crypto reference-price observations and verify signed receipts. Limited BTC, ETH and SOL samples need no API key. Catalogue rows and surrounding metadata are unsigned; coverage and account allowances vary.

settings.name: Pulse API key (optional)
settings.description: Leave blank for limited BTC, ETH and SOL samples. For broader requests, use your own developer key from https://thepulse.markets/developers (Developer plan, no charge). Access and usage allowances depend on your account.
